text: Austria has long, **white** licence plates with the standard **blue EU strip** on the left.
NOTE: Italian plates have two blue strips, on both sides of the plate. Italian plates also tend to be noticeably shorter.
Swiss plates are long and white, but lack the blue strip.
text_zh: 奧地利使用長條形**白色**車牌，左側有標準的**藍色歐盟條紋**。
註：義大利車牌的兩側都有藍色條紋。義大利車牌通常也明顯較短。
瑞士車牌為長條形白色，但沒有藍色條紋。

text: Austria uses white** **bollards, with a **black top**. The colour of the reflector is **(dark) red or dark grey**.
Many bollards also feature a small nipple-shaped black cap on the top. Bollards sometimes have a [snow pole on top](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8).
NOTE: Slovenia and Montenegro use the same bollards, but with bright red reflectors instead of grey or dark red. Germany uses simple white bollards with grey reflectors.
text_zh: 奧地利使用白色** **路樁，帶有**黑色頂部**。反光片的顏色為**（深）紅色或深灰色**。
許多路樁頂部還有一個突起的黑色小蓋。路樁頂部有時會附有[除雪桿](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8)。
註：斯洛維尼亞和蒙特內哥羅使用相同的路樁，但反光片為鮮紅色，而非灰色或深紅色。德國則使用帶有灰色反光片的簡約白色路樁。

text: Austria uses two colour schemes for **chevrons**:
- white on red
- red on yellow
NOTE: Germany mostly uses red on white chevrons, and rarely red on yellow.
text_zh: 奧地利的**轉彎標誌**使用兩種配色方案：
- 紅底白標
- 黃底紅標
註：德國大部分使用白底紅標轉彎標誌，極少使用黃底紅標。

text: Round **wooden** poles are the most common type of pole found in Austria.
text_zh: 圓形**木製**電線桿是奧地利最常見的電線桿類型。

text: Most of Austria is **mountainous** and covered in forests. However, some areas in the east and northeast are much more flat and agricultural.
text_zh: 奧地利大部分地區**多山**且被森林覆蓋。然而，東部和東北部的一些地區則較為平坦且以農業為主。

text: Alpine architecture is common in Austria and other countries in the Alps. Houses commonly have distinct **light **coloured walls, with **wooden **elements such as balconies or panelling around the top floor, with dark-coloured wooden roofs that extend outward. The roofs can sometimes be angled downward at the front and back. In addition, houses are also often multi-storeyed.
NOTE: Germany uses similar architecture in its southern states.
text_zh: 阿爾卑斯山建築風格在奧地利和其他阿爾卑斯山區國家很常見。房屋通常具有獨特的**淺 **色牆面，頂層帶有陽台或牆板等**木製 **元素，並配有向外延伸的深色木製屋頂。屋頂有時前後向下傾斜。此外，房屋通常為多層建築。
註：德國在其南部各州也使用類似的建築風格。

text: The official language of Austria is **German**. The German language uses the special letters Ä, Ö, Ü and ß.

NOTE: The other majority German-speaking countries with coverage are Switzerland and Germany. In addition, German is spoken in [East Belgium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German-speaking_Community_of_Belgium) and the Italian province of [South Tyrol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Tyrol).
text_zh: 奧地利的官方語言是**德語**。德語使用特殊字母 Ä、Ö、Ü 和 ß。
註：其他具有街景覆蓋且主要使用德語的國家為瑞士和德國。此外，[比利時東部](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German-speaking_Community_of_Belgium)和義大利的[南蒂羅爾](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Tyrol)省也講德語。

text: You can tell the three German-speaking countries apart by **camera meta **alone:

- Austria only has **Generation 3** and Generation 4 coverage (the only exceptions being Generation 2 on [one road](https://goo.gl/maps/LebHyLrqsjkqyoZMA) in Burgenland, and several [ski resort trekkers](https://goo.gl/maps/pdquUsUJoNwZghxRA)).
- Germany only has Generation 4 coverage. (the only exceptions being spills and trekkers)
- Switzerland car coverage is always [low-cam](https://goo.gl/maps/Ey7aUdEn6vc76BZc8). This can be recognized by the much bigger car blur.
text_zh: 你光憑**相機線索特徵**就能區分這三個德語國家：
- 奧地利僅有 **第 3 代** 和第 4 代街景覆蓋（唯一的例外是布 Burgenland 的[某條道路](https://goo.gl/maps/LebHyLrqsjkqyoZMA)上有第 2 代，以及幾個[滑雪場徒步拍攝](https://goo.gl/maps/pdquUsUJoNwZghxRA)）。
- 德國只有 Generation 4 街景覆蓋。（唯一的例外是外溢畫面和徒步拍攝）
- 瑞士的汽車街景覆蓋永遠是[低鏡頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Ey7aUdEn6vc76BZc8)。這可以透過大得多的車輛模糊來識別。

text: Austria also has generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
NOTE: Most of Western Europe also has smallcam.
text_zh: 奧地利也有 Generation 4 的「小鏡頭」（smallcam）街景覆蓋，其架設高度比一般的 Generation 4 還低，並且有一個相對較大的圓形模糊，前端帶有一個小突起。這種模糊有時也會完全透明，讓人更難察覺。
註：西歐大部分地區也有小鏡頭。

text: Direction signs have a white background, a **blue outline**, and a unique font.
text_zh: 方向指示牌為白底、**藍色外框**，並使用獨特的字體。

text: Similar white signs with a** **blue outline and unique font can also be seen at the **entrance of towns**.
NOTE: Germany uses [yellow town entrance signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fLnrUWoSDqzsyGxx5) with a black outline.
text_zh: 在**城鎮入口**也能看到類似的白色標誌，帶有**藍色外框**和獨特字體。
註：德國使用的是帶有黑色外框的[黃色城鎮入口標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fLnrUWoSDqzsyGxx5)。

text: **Green** signs can commonly be seen, giving directions to different local facilities.
text_zh: 常見的**綠色**標誌會指示通往當地不同設施的方向。

text: **Pedestrian signs** have a unique design: instead of zebra stripes, they have two horizontal dashed lines.
NOTE: All neighbouring countries have pedestrian signs with zebra stripes.
text_zh: **行人標誌**有獨特的設計：它們沒有斑馬線，而是兩條水平虛線。
註：所有鄰國的行人標誌都有斑馬線圖案。

text: Road signs in Austria are sometimes mounted by **four metal clips**, which is unique within central Europe. However, plenty of Austrian signs are attached in other ways.
text_zh: 奧地利的道路標誌有時會用**四個金屬夾**固定，這在中歐是獨一無二的。不過，也有許多奧地利標誌是以其他方式固定。

text: **Road markers** are blue with white numbers. They have one decimal separated by a comma, making them very recognizable.
NOTE: Slovenian road markers are white. And German markers have a thin white outline.
text_zh: **道路里程牌**為藍底白字。它們包含一個以逗號分隔的小數點，非常容易辨認。
註：斯洛維尼亞的道路里程牌是白色的。而德國的里程牌則有一圈細白邊。

text: Austrian **bus stop signs** contain a yellow and green circle with the letter **H**.
NOTE: This design is relatively unique in Europe. The only other country with similar bus stop signs is Germany.
text_zh: 奧地利的**公車站牌**包含一個黃綠相間的圓圈，中間帶有字母 **H**。
註：這種設計在歐洲相當獨特。唯一擁有類似公車站牌的國家是德國。

text: These one-way traffic signs, with the word **‘EINBAHN’** written on them, are unique to Austria.
NOTE: In Germany there will be “Einbahnstraße” written on the sign.
text_zh: 這些寫有 **‘EINBAHN’** 字樣的單行道交通標誌是奧地利特有的。
註：在德國，標誌上會寫著「Einbahnstraße」。

text: “No Stopping” and “No Waiting” signs in Austria will often have the words “Anfang” or “Ende” (meaning “beginning” and “end”) written on, or below, them.
text_zh: 奧地利的「禁止停車」和「禁止臨時停車」標誌上或下方，經常會寫有「Anfang」或「Ende」（意為「開始」與「結束」）字樣。

text: These simple dead-end signs with a **white upside down T** are mostly unique to Austria.
Most countries in Europe use [this sign](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cB2CMCs6fQTNTZPQ8).
NOTE: Older coverage in Switzerland can be seen using [this design](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yv3PkLHesS63WCYD7) as well.
text_zh: 這種帶有**白色倒 T 形**的簡易無路可通標誌主要為奧地利獨有。
歐洲大多數國家使用的是[這種標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cB2CMCs6fQTNTZPQ8)。
註：瑞士較舊的街景覆蓋中也可以看到[這種設計](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yv3PkLHesS63WCYD7)。

text: These **yellow **natural gas poles, which resemble snow poles, are unique to Austria.
text_zh: 這些看起來像雪桿的**黃色**天然氣桿是奧地利獨有的。

text: **Elevation** is very important when region-guessing Austria based on landscape alone.

The central and western parts of Austria are the most mountainous. The flatter areas are found in the east, mostly near the borders. Note that “flat” is a relative concept in Austria: even in the flat areas, rolling hills are still common.
text_zh: 當單憑景觀在奧地利進行區域猜測時，**海拔高度**非常重要。
奧地利的中部和西部多山。較平坦的區域位於東部，大多靠近邊境。請注意，在奧地利「平坦」是個相對概念：即使在平坦區域，起伏的丘陵依然相當常見。

text: A map of Austrian **A-roads **can be seen here, following the general trend of increasing in number from east to west.
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧地利 **A 級道路**地圖點此查看，編號大致遵循由東向西遞增的趨勢。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Austrian **B-roads**, indicated by white text inside of a blue rectangle, also follow the general trend of increasing in number from east to west.
An important exception to this are roads 222-230, which are located inside the state of Vienna.
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧地利 **B 級道路**以藍色矩形內的白字標示，編號同樣遵循由東向西遞增的大趨勢。
一個重要的例外是 222 至 230 號道路，它們位於維也納州境內。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Each Austrian state has its own **unique flag**, shown in the image.
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧地利的每個邦都有其**獨特的旗幟**，如圖所示。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Each Austrian state has its own **unique **bus company, the logo of which can be seen on the side of buses.
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧地利的每個邦都有其**獨特的**公車公司，其標誌可以在公車車身側面看到。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Bus stops consisting of **neon-yellow poles** are found in Vorarlberg.
text_zh: 由**螢光黃色桿子**組成的公車站牌可在福拉爾貝格邦找到。

text: These **yellow and white stripes** around poles and signposts are found in Vorarlberg.
text_zh: 柱子和標誌桿上的這些**黃白相間條紋**出現在福拉爾貝格邦。

text: **White kilometre markers** can be found in Vorarlberg as well as on a road in [western Salzburg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sDKDbQ2Czn1zkd59A).
text_zh: **白色公里牌**可以在福拉爾貝格邦以及[薩爾斯堡州西部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sDKDbQ2Czn1zkd59A)的一條道路上找到。

text: A large **white** **painted square** in the middle of the road can be found next to kilometre markers in Salzburg.
text_zh: 在薩爾斯堡州的公里牌旁，道路中央常能看到一個**白色**的**噴漆方塊**。

text: **Green** “[Güterweg](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%BCterweg)” signs are found in Burgenland.
text_zh: 布根蘭州可見**綠色**的“[Güterweg](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%BCterweg)”標誌。

text: **White** “Güterweg” signs with a **black outline** are mainly found in Upper Austria.
text_zh: 帶有**黑色外框**的**白色**「Güterweg」標誌主要見於上奧地利州。

text: In Lower Austria, you may find signs with **yellow and blue sign borders**, corresponding to the [flag of the region](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg/2560px-Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg.png).
text_zh: 在下奧地利州，你可能會看到帶有**黃藍相間標誌邊框**的標誌，這對應了[該地區的旗幟](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg/2560px-Flag_of_Lower_Austria_%28state%29.svg.png)。

text: **Vineyards** are limited to the far eastern part of the country.
You can find a very precise map [here](https://vineyards.com/photos/maps/Austria%20Wine%20Map.png). Notably, there are a lot of vineyards close to Vienna and around Lake Neusiedl.
text_zh: **葡萄園**僅限於該國的最東部地區。
你可以在[這裡](https://vineyards.com/photos/maps/Austria%20Wine%20Map.png)找到非常精確的地圖。值得注意的是，維也納附近和新塞爾湖周圍有許多葡萄園。

text: The **highest parts of the Alps** are found in the west and central parts of the country.

The tallest mountains are found in the panhandle of Austria, on the Italian border. These mountains can be recognized by their generally sharper peak and [grander appearance](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1389055,10.2855153,3a,75y,66.33h,92.53t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTDJ_tFCAlBIH4nUIgmkiMw!2e0!5s20200901T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: **阿爾卑斯山最高的部分**部位於該國的西部和中部。

最高聳的山脈位於奧地利的狹長地帶、與義大利交界處。這些山峰的特徵通常是山頂更為尖銳且[氣勢更為雄偉](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1389055,10.2855153,3a,75y,66.33h,92.53t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTDJ_tFCAlBIH4nUIgmkiMw!2e0!5s20200901T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。

text: This unique **tin foil antenna** can be found in western** **Austria, mostly near the Swiss border.
NOTE: This antenna is unique to Austria.
text_zh: 這種獨特的**錫箔天線**可以在奧地利西部** **找到，大多靠近瑞士邊境。
註：這種天線是奧地利獨有的。

text: **Vienna street signs** are extremely recognizable dark blue plaques with a traditional-looking white serif font. The number at the start will indicate which district you are in (see the map).
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **維也納的路牌**極具辨識度，為深藍色牌子，印有傳統風格的白色襯線字體。開頭的數字標示你所在的區（參見地圖）。
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Most other major cities in Austria also have their own **unique street signs**.
NOTE: Many of the arbitrary blue ones can look similar, but the 4 listed in the graphic can be differentiated by:
- Vienna - District Number
- Salzburg - Unique Font
- Klagenfurt - Irregular White Border
- St Polten - Rounded White Border
_You can click the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧地利大多數其他主要城市也有其**獨特的路牌**。
註：許多隨處可見的藍色路牌看起來很像，但圖表中列出的 4 個可以透過以下方式區分：
- 維也納 - 區號
- 薩爾斯堡 - 獨特字體
- 克拉根福 - 不規則白色邊框
- 聖帕爾滕 - 圓角白色邊框
_你可以點擊圖片放大。_

text: Poles in Vienna and [Innsbruck](https://goo.gl/maps/MWpqa8t1cVzunLrz9) feature these **red**-and-**white **pieces of tape that look like the Austrian flag. They can be differentiated by the fact that the tapes in [Vienna](https://goo.gl/maps/N4tkGXcAt1sbjxNy7) are thinner, and there are typically two on each pole.
text_zh: 維也納和[因斯布魯克](https://goo.gl/maps/MWpqa8t1cVzunLrz9)的電線桿上帶有這些**紅**與**白**相間膠帶，看起來像奧地利國旗。兩者可以這樣區分：[維也納](https://goo.gl/maps/N4tkGXcAt1sbjxNy7)的膠帶較細，且每根電線桿上通常有兩條。

text: **Lake Constance** (known in German as the Bodensee) is a large lake on the western border of Austria. It can be recognized by its vastness, which is not seen in other lakes within the mountainous part of the country.
text_zh: **波登湖**（德語稱為 Bodensee）是位於奧地利西部邊境的大型湖泊。它的辨識特徵在於其廣闊的湖面，這是該國山區其他湖泊所沒有的。
